changelog: Sync from structs-ai v1.25.0: updated content, commands, and mechanics for v0.21.0
summary: Installs the structsd binary. Covers downloading prebuilt release binaries (recommended) and building from source via the Makefile (Go 1.23+). Use when structsd is not found, when setting up a new machine, or when the agent needs to install or update the Structs chain binary.
